name: Prompt-Aligned Action-Resolvable Uncertainty — RSS Evidence Ladder

gates.name: Frozen-policy reproduction
gates.pass_condition: Exact public pi05_libero wiring reproduces stock behavior.

gates.name: Primitive capability before decision claims
gates.pass_condition: Every enabled action has a context-declared reliability lower bound at least 0.80; also report whether it passes the original 0.90 standard.
gates.current: ACT 100/100; T01 drawer-joint opening 97/100. The separate visual information-effect gate is RP3. Other actions remain disabled.

gates.name: Prompt-aligned typed belief
gates.pass_condition: Calibrated OBSERVED, VIEWPOINT_BLOCKED, MANIPULATION_ONLY, and ABSENT belief passes prompt, cause, and scene-disjoint counterfactuals.
gates.current: PIU V0 replaces the online two-state label with a target-location fact over visible workspace, middle drawer, other unsearched region, and absent. Only visible workspace and middle drawer have training data. Its old-seed diagnostic is 27/30; object-level maps, ABSENT, and scene-disjoint tests remain missing.

gates.name: Calibrated action-effect branches
gates.pass_condition: Six-point RGB/proprioceptive critic recognizes FAILED, REVEALED, and EMPTY, while full-executor effect rates pass context-disjoint reliability gates.
gates.current: OPEN_AND_OBSERVE and a hierarchical six-frame critic are implemented. The v7 development result is invalid because its evaluator checked target visibility only in the final frame. Debug seed 770 saw the target during opening and lost it after return, which v7 would call EMPTY. The run was stopped at 77/300; 700-799 are debug-only. Temporal-label v3 then froze on 600-659, but v8 failed development: FAILED 7/7, REVEALED 7/9, EMPTY 4/5. A five-pixel label mismatch motivated an architecture-derived 256-pixel resolvability contract. Its old-seed v9 diagnostic is 20/21; untouched 660-699 must pass before the sealed 900-999 audit. The physical lower bound is 0.80; conformal alpha remains 0.10. The v4 collector now separates the OffScreen controller from post-termination evaluator replay. Local seed-1399 disposable smoke passes REVEALED, EMPTY, and FAILED, and the PIU six-frame head predicts all five end-to-end smoke branches correctly. These are reused non-claim diagnostics; untouched 660-699 must still pass before the sealed 900-999 audit.

gates.name: Expected-risk optimization
gates.pass_condition: ACT, information actions, and NOT_FOUND are selected from measured costs and effects, with no tuned confidence threshold and with preregistered sensitivity.
gates.current: Finite-horizon planner and cost sweep pass target-observability routing at 296/300. The minimal T01 runner bypasses probabilistic temporal q and applies hard action validity from deterministic control memory. Context- specific terminal ACT effects, multi-action history, and NOT_FOUND are not yet physically tested. PIU V0 additionally completes one disposable live sequence OPEN -> singleton outcome -> belief update -> replan using explicit EIG/task utility and the 0.924 OPEN reliability lower bound.

gates.name: Oracle-free history-dependent closed loop
gates.pass_condition: The deployed loop uses only policy RGB, prompt, action, and public history for routing, outcome recognition, stopping, retry, and belief update.
gates.current: Source/runtime guards and the five-case embodied smoke show zero online oracle inputs; evaluator scoring uses a separate environment or action replay after terminal. The learned heads are development/diagnostic only, so this is not clean validation.

gates.name: Decision benefit and ablations
gates.pass_condition: Beat monolithic, prompt-blind, action-spread, CoMe-style binary information-sufficiency, uncalibrated typed-belief, visual-only-history, no-history, and no-effect baselines on a frozen held-out paper test set.
gates.current: T01 beats three fixed rules; the paper test set and key ablations are missing.

gates.name: Active-perception breadth
gates.pass_condition: Demonstrate viewpoint discovery, manipulation discovery, and information enrichment with independently capable actions.
gates.current: Only manipulation discovery by middle-layer opening is certified.

gates.name: Final task benefit
gates.pass_condition: Information acquisition improves final task success, not only target visibility.
gates.current: OPEN_CONTAINER then ACT is 0/5; direct open-drawer retrieval is 0/5.

gates.name: Held-out generalization
gates.pass_condition: Hold out objects, clutter, occlusion severity, containers, and scenes; reproduce the decision benefit with a second frozen policy.

gates.name: Reproducible paper release
gates.pass_condition: One-command experiment, frozen hashes, automatic gate report, failure demos, concise README, and verified GPU shutdown.
gates.current: Immutable runners, hashes, and strict failure reports exist; the complete paper runner and final artifacts do not. The post-run GPU check found no project process; only the desktop service remained.

gates.name: Prompt-safe temporal task compliance
gates.pass_condition: A specification frozen before paper testing contains only generic task predicates, maintains a calibrated belief over finite-trace progress, and achieves a one-sided 95% lower bound of at least 0.90 for trajectory satisfaction without premature commit or false NOT_FOUND.
gates.current: An exact product-belief automaton, logic-risk term, and explicit SAFE_STOP branch are implemented and unit-tested. The proposition calibration, logic/deferral losses, deployed trace monitor, and held-out trajectory evidence are not yet frozen or measured.
